Class MLDSASignatureAlgorithm

java.lang.Object
tech.kwik.agent15.pqc.impl.MLDSASignatureAlgorithm
All Implemented Interfaces:
SignatureAlgorithm
Direct Known Subclasses:
MLDSA44SignatureAlgorithm, MLDSA65SignatureAlgorithm, MLDSA87SignatureAlgorithm
public abstract class MLDSASignatureAlgorithm extends Object implements SignatureAlgorithm
ML-DSA (FIPS 204), the post-quantum signature scheme underlying the mldsa44/mldsa65/mldsa87 TLS signature schemes.

Unlike RSA-PSS/ECDSA, a single JCA algorithm name ("ML-DSA") handles signing and verifying for all three parameter sets; the parameter set is carried by the key itself. So the only thing that differs per subclass is keyMatchesScheme(PublicKey), which needs a way to tell an ML-DSA-44 key from an ML-DSA-65 or ML-DSA-87 one: the JDK's getAlgorithm() reports "ML-DSA" for all three, but each parameter set's public key has a distinct, fixed X.509-encoded length, which is what subclasses pass in here.

    • computePublicKeyEncodedLength

      protected static int computePublicKeyEncodedLength(String algorithm)
      Generates a throwaway key pair for the given ML-DSA parameter set (e.g. "ML-DSA-65") and returns its public key's X.509-encoded length, so subclasses don't have to hardcode a JDK/ASN.1-derived number.
